title: プログラミング基礎Ⅱ
subtitle: Programming Basics II
educationalGoal: Students will learn the basics of the C programming language, as computer programs are essential for developing robots, particularly for implementing motion control and environmental information acquisition.
advice:
This is a basic course in the C programming language. We will cover the following topics:
1.	Pointers
2.	Applications of arrays and pointers
3.	Structures, unions, and enumerations
4.	File input/output

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are required to bring their own laptop computers for use in exercises.
Students are required to be aware of the instructor's messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class, as the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
requiredKnowledge:
Completion of “Programming Basics I.”
Ability to type efficiently.

activityGoals.body: Understand how a basic C program works.

2.	Applications of arrays and pointers
3.	Structures, unions, and enumerations
4.	File input/output

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.

Students are required to be aware of the instructor's messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class, as the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
